instructions: Return only a valid JSON object matching structure, without Markdown fences or commentary.
The example defines the format only; replace its values with the supplied source and evidence.
Return one array item per policy. All seven fields are required; do not add other fields.
If the entire supplied PDF contain no qualifying policies, return the empty_result object.

policies.policy: One concrete action or target in English.
policies.quote: An exact supporting excerpt from the cited source page.

field_rules.period_start: Integer strategy start year copied from the supplied source.
field_rules.period_end: Integer strategy end year copied from the supplied source.
field_rules.policy: Nonblank English description of one supported action or target.
field_rules.type: One of the policy_types defined in the prompt rules.
field_rules.source_file: Exact filename of the supplied source.
field_rules.page: One-based integer physical PDF page number.
field_rules.quote: Exact supporting excerpt of at least 20 characters from the cited page.
